subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this 14-action batch be accepted only after the required direct sibling Codex audit and completed exact-head workflow checks?
rationale: The PR updates third-party code executed with secrets and release permissions, while the repository's mandatory direct `../codex` inspection could not be satisfied in this review environment.

options.title: Require direct audit
options.body: Keep the PR pending until an owner inspects `../codex` CLI argument and sandbox contracts and all exact-head workflow checks finish.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate the Codex, token, registry, and release-action bumps from lower-privilege setup-action updates to reduce the review boundary.

options.title: Accept the batch
options.body: A workflow owner may intentionally accept the official pinned releases after documenting upstream review and confirming the full exact-head matrix is green.

recommendation.title: Require direct audit
recommendation.body: Keep the PR pending until an owner inspects `../codex` CLI argument and sandbox contracts and all exact-head workflow checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the broadest involvement in Codex-agent workflows, core CI, Docker release automation, and action-version modernization.
